scope: Visible search field above every workspace map and in-memory nearby gauges, county road records and authorized loaded assets for stream/road selections. No new AGOL items, access changes, hazard thresholds or dispatch logic.

implementation.sdk: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript 5.1, existing unified loader
implementation.distance: geodeticDistanceOperator in meters between WGS84 XY geometries; conservative envelope prefilter includes every potentially nearby part
implementation.counts: All matches; independent of map extent and sidebar display filters
implementation.publicIndex: Existing versioned v0.31.0 name/geometry snapshot unchanged
implementation.persistence: None for queries, vicinity results, private records or credentials

privacyAndFailureTests: Sign-out/unload clears private vicinity details and map graphics immediately.
Delayed calculations cannot restore private results after sign-out.
New selection, clearing and source refresh invalidate superseded calculations.
Missing CRS, malformed locations and failed distance measurements remain unknown.
Failed road feeds preserve warnings; explicitly inactive records are optional history. Elapsed dates never establish reopening.
limits: Nearby is geographic vicinity along every same-name mapped part, including disconnected segments. It is not network connectivity, travel time, predicted flooding, safe access or a resource deployment recommendation.

Only configured gauges, returned road records and currently loaded authorized assets participate. Private asset acceptance used fictional records; no additional real-account sign-in or permission change was performed.
Public display geometry is generalized by five meters; no engineering survey or elevation accuracy is implied.
integration: Preserved and merged remote c49b3dc flood-scenario traffic playback changes without conflicts; post-merge regression suite passes.
rollback: Redeploy c49b3dc (preceding 0.31.0 site including scenario traffic); no data migration.
